raw.Plan_Review_Results_Comments:
Inspections: 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9
Approved on 8-18, SH
Following issues were emaild on 8-5, plans at my desk:
I have received revised sheets for this project and still have a couple of issues.  
For item 1, I called out the 48” x 49” footing on sheet S-101, and detail for this footing are still lacking.  I do see that a description was added for the enlarged footing at the other end of the 8 ¾” x 33” GLB, please provide similar details/description for both of these footings.
Is item 7 addressed?  I do not find a description of the hanger/connection for these beams.

Following issues were emaild on 7-16, plans at my desk:
I am doing the plan review on this addition and found a few issues with the plans which need to be addressed:
1-	No Demo Plan.  Sheet S-101 shows a 48” x 49” x 12” footing with 5) #4 E.W.  The existing plan shows a 36” x 36” x10” footing with 3) #4 E.W.  Is the footing being replaced or enlarged?  Please explain or detail the new or enlarged footing.
2-	Sheet S-101 specifies a 4” concrete garage floor, and there is a note for finishing a garage/carport floor.  If this is to be a covered patio please call it out as such.
3-	Sheet S-101 shows the footings for the patio cover support but does not give dimensions or details on that page.  The size and rebar are called out on Sheet S-102, but having this spelled out on the foundation plan would benefit those in the field.  Also specify the concrete pier size and any rebar.  Detail 5 on sheet S-103 may be the detail for the patio cover posts, but no notes or sizes are shown.
4-	The patio cover posts, post bases and post caps are specified on the renderings, but not the plans.  Please call out these elements on the foundation, floor plan or framing plans as appropriate.
5-	Show wall bracing on the floor plan, or provide a braced wall plan.  
6-	A portal frame is mentioned on sheet S-103, this wall would not meet the criteria for a portal frame as there is a rake wall above, and not a pony wall.  If the wall bracing can not be done prescriptively it will need to be engineered. 
7-	Specify the connection between the 3 microlams and the wall.

4- Where mirrors are located above lavatories, a mirror shall be located over the accessible lavatory and shall be mounted with the bottom edge of the reflecting surface 40 inches maximum above the floor.
5- Maximum reach height for paper towel dispenser to be no more that 48" above finish floor.
6- Handles, pulls, latches, locks, and other operable parts on accessible doors shall have a shape that is easy to grasp with one hand and does not require tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist to operate.

raw.BP_Zoning2_Results_Comments: CR2007-7 (SEE CONDITION 4 PER EMILY & DAN)
raw.Event_ResultComments:
At time of inspection I found the 18x20 shed had been constructed with no foundation.  The floor consists of 2x6 PT rim joists with untreated 2x4's used for floor joists.  While there are provisions for freestanding decks built without a foundation, these provisions would not extend to a floor deck supporting walls and a roof.  Also R317.1 states that floor joists within 18" of exposed ground need to be " naturally durable wood, or wood that is preservative-treated".  

I have not addressed any additional framing issues which may exists due to the absence of an appropriate foundation.

There are 2 options to bring the structure into compliance:
1- Reduce the size of the structure to 200sf or less, such that it is our of our purview.
2- Resubmit plans showing a foundation and floor system capable of supporting the walls and roof.  Ensure that the existing walls and roof, if they remain, meet the minimum requirements detailed on the approved plans, OR, provide new plans for the structure.
